build.buildCommand: if [ "${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-}" = "@workspace/blockchain-hub" ]; then pnpm --filter @workspace/blockchain-hub run build; elif [ "${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-}" = "@workspace/admin-panel" ]; then pnpm --filter @workspace/admin-panel run build; else pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ "${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-}" = "@workspace/blockchain-hub" ]; then pnpm --filter @workspace/blockchain-hub run serve; elif [ "${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-}" = "@workspace/admin-panel" ]; then pnpm --filter @workspace/admin-panel run serve; else pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start; fi
